nodes.name: Webhook
nodes.notes: Copy this node's Production URL into the app env var N8N_VARIABLE_SYNC_URL. App POSTs { org_id, client_id } with header x-n8n-secret.

parameters.query:
SELECT DISTINCT ON (bot_template_id, variable_name)
       bot_template_id,
       variable_name,
       variable_string_value AS variable_value
FROM   chat_log_variable
WHERE  org_id     = $1
  AND  client_id  = $2
  AND  is_deleted = false
  AND  variable_name IS NOT NULL
  AND  created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '15 days'
ORDER  BY bot_template_id, variable_name, created_at DESC;

nodes.name: Query Source DB
nodes.notes: Newest value per (bot_template_id, variable_name). Needs covering index idx_clv_tpl for index-only scan.

nodes.name: POST results to app
nodes.notes: x-n8n-secret MUST equal the app's N8N_WEBHOOK_SECRET. Replace YOUR_APP_URL with the deployed app origin.
